title: antirrhinum majus var. hendersonii
intro: Antirrhinum majus var. hendersonii, commonly known as the pink snapdragon, is a variety of flowering plant belonging to the snapdragon family (Scrophulariaceae). This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health conditions, including inflammation and anxiety disorders, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Antirrhinum majus var. hendersonii include its sedative, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic effects, which help to soothe and calm the body. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and iridoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
